title: a path: selector naming a folder that is not a worktree of the repo is rejected before any Orca call
source: intended: owner decision, defect N-22: the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision, defect N-22). A real launch checks a path-naming selector before it writes anything or calls Orca: a folder that is not a worktree of this repo exits 2 with no Orca call, no launch folder and no registry line.
